editorial.blurb: Seoul Bites delivers authentic Korean comfort food in a welcoming, visually appealing space where everything arrives fast and tastes mouthwatering.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the kalbi and Korean fried wings together—reviewers rave about both, and the restaurant's self-serve setup with sauce stations and extra plates makes sharing easy for groups.

topDishes.note: Perfect texture and spice balance; crispy and flavorful in sweet-and-spicy and orange varieties
